disqualifier.note: Independent equality helpers composed into sameViolation (focus/path plus optional source shape/component plus message/severity). Overlap is legal; hasPredicate is a separate quad-predicate check. Not a masked union.

Independent relationship helpers: key equality vs membership vs both endpoints present in the visible resource map. relationshipExists uses sameRelationship; mixed true/false is ordinary graph filtering.
Independent dataset membership helpers: serialized-quad equality vs list membership vs subject-key presence. hasQuad uses sameQuad; hasSubjectKey keys a different index. Mixed combinations are legal.

Independent match-basis filters: uniqueness within one side vs disjointness across left/right. Independent-evidence kinds require disjointness; same-source-overlap allows overlap. Mixed pass/fail is legal.
Pairwise proposal-id equivalence plus the list-level uniqueness fold over it. Both-true is a duplicate pair; both-false is distinct ids. Not exclusive dispatch phases.

Independent seal checks on different record types; verifyOutcomeBinding ANDs the two hashes with runKey/decisionHash binding. Mixed fail/pass is legal (one record can be intact while the other is not).
Independent span checks: internal range/quote coherence vs provenance-anchor equivalence. A span can be internally consistent and still fail matchesAnchor (or the reverse on a different anchor).
S.is guards over different values: markdown Ol blocks vs ambiguous transition tokens (including/having). Match.when(isOrderedList) and the transition check never share a subject.
S.is guards for different NativeSelect values (view mode all/tbox/abox vs fold L0-L3). Each onChange feeds a different atom; they are not exclusive-read of one string.
Alternative includesEdge callbacks for different graphs: full-adjacency always-true vs community-artery threshold. Call sites pass one or the other; they are not stored parallel flags on one record.
Independent runner refusals: shapes partition empty vs session signature changed mid-flight. Each writes a different OntologyValidationStatus (blocked vs idle); mixed true/false is legal.
S.is(IdentifiedPatentReference) plus equivalence of two PatentReferences. sameIdentified ANDs identification with samePatentReference; unidentified-and-unequal is a legal no-match.

Independent inferred-graph helpers: triple-key membership vs ordered type-key equality vs whether rdf:type keys changed across modules. typeBearingInferenceChanged is !sameTypeKeys; hasExistingTriple filters new quads. Mixed use is legal.

Independent persistence checks: proposal targets the supersession head, every proposal is applicable, an edge matches a candidate belief, a receipt matches the submit command. Interval probes already triaged; these remaining ANDs are free combinations.

Independent Postgres diagnostics: unique-violation sqlstate/message vs the diagnostic mentioning idempotency_key. AND-folded into conflict translation; unique-without-that-key is a different constraint.

evidence.note: maxResults early-return writes conforms:false with truncated:true; the completion write at line 208 sets truncated:false and conforms from violations.length===0, so truncated-and-conforming is never constructed.
Truncation fires only when violations.length >= maxResults, so truncated => has-violations => !conforms.
toVerdict admits only conforms && !truncated; truncated-true is folded into rejected with no combined-true arm.

notes: Validation completeness conforming|violating|truncated flattened into two bits. Schema lives in semantic-web; this is the in-lane exclusive writer.
